Subject: Nexera vendor setup — DPA, SOC 2 link, subprocessor list & PO routing

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Procurement is starting vendor intake for Redwood and we need to collect the following artifacts before we can raise a PO:

- Signed DPA (or DPA markups accepted via DocuSign)
- Current SOC 2 report (or hosted read-only link)
- Full subprocessor list (with vendor roles and locations)
- W-9 / vendor tax form (US) and a point of contact for invoices

I attached Nexera's standard procurement intake form — please confirm where Redwood prefers invoices to be sent and whether you accept Nexera's standard e-sign flow. Also: do you require a specific PO header value for forecasting?

Can you loop in whoever handles signatures and legal? If you can send the DPA and SOC2 link back, we’ll route internally and aim to issue a PO within 3 business days after the DPA is accepted.

Appreciate it —
Emma
Emma Clarke
Senior Buyer, Vendor Operations
Nexera, Inc.
emma@nexera.com
(415) 555-0124

Attachments: Nexera_Procurement_Form.pdf
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Emma Clarke <emma@nexera.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 13:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Nexera vendor setup — DPA, SOC 2 link, subprocessor list & PO routing

Hi Emma — thanks for the checklist and the form. Looping in Laura (legal ops) and Ben (finance) so we can close this quickly.

Quick answers up front:
- We can sign Nexera's DPA via DocuSign; we also attach Redwood's standard DPA (Redwood_DPA_v1.2.pdf) for your legal team's review if you prefer our template.
- SOC 2 report: hosted read-only link below (current 2026 report).
- Subprocessor list: attached CSV with vendor roles and hosting regions.
- Invoice remit: invoices@redwood.com; standard PO header is "NEXERA-PO-<PO_NUMBER>" but we accept plain PO numbers in the body if your ERP requires it.

DocuSign: we can either (A) sign your DPA via the DocuSign packet you provide, or (B) we can send our DPA for signature. If you'd like us to initiate signature, say so and we'll route today.

Ben — do you need any further tax/vendor paperwork beyond the W-9 that Emma attached?

Next steps proposed:
1) Emma confirms whether Nexera wants Redwood to initiate DocuSign or Nexera to send.
2) Legal and procurement agree on the DPA variant and sign.
3) Nexera uploads PO or returns PO number and we process activation and invoice setup.

Link: SOC2 report — https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/reports/SOC2-Redwood-2026.html

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Vendor Partnerships | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v1.2.pdf, Redwood_subprocessor_list.csv

Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Nexera vendor setup — DPA, SOC 2 link, subprocessor list & PO routing

Thanks Priyom — that was fast.

Nexera prefers that vendors initiate DocuSign when they have a standard DPA. Please go ahead and send Redwood_DPA_v1.2.pdf through DocuSign and copy procurement@proc.nexera.com. We also have a quick clarifying question for the subprocessor list: can you confirm whether any subprocessors have access to plaintext customer data (yes/no) and whether any subprocessors are in APAC EEA latency zones — procurement flags that separately for data sovereignty. If you can add a single-column note to the CSV called "access_level" with values like "no_plaintext" / "limited_decrypt" / "full_decrypt" that will speed review.

Also: our procurement system requires a vendor tax ID (EIN) on file — I didn't see it filled on your form. Can you attach a W-9 and confirm remit address?

If everything is in order we will generate a preliminary PO number within 48 hours of signature.

Best,
Emma

Hi Emma — sending everything over as requested.

Actions completed:
- I initiated DocuSign using Redwood_DPA_v1.2.pdf and included procurement@proc.nexera.com in the routing. DocuSign packet link: https://docusign.com/packet/abcdef123456
- Updated subprocessor CSV to include an "access_level" column; attached as Redwood_subprocessor_list.csv. Summary: no subprocessors have "full_decrypt" access; a small set have "limited_decrypt" for tokenization/transcoding pipelines (entries noted).
- Attached a W-9 and confirmed remit address: invoices@redwood.com / Redwood Inference, 480 Market St, Suite 900, San Francisco, CA 94104.

Ben — we will need a vendor setup in your vendor master once the PO is issued; PO number should flow to invoices@redwood.com. Is there any additional metadata Nexera needs on the invoice (cost center, booking code)?

Emma — once DocuSign completes please share the generated signature PDF and PO number and we’ll treat this as "vendor active". If Nexera prefers, we can also accept a signed PDF uploaded to your vendor portal.

Thanks everyone — trying to keep this under 48 hours.

Regards,
Priyom Das
